body.message:
Rate for the Viridian 2 Bedrooms is AED 13,000 for 30 nights, which is the best we can offer. A security deposit of AED 3,000 will also apply.

For City Walk, we currently do not have any 2-bedroom + maid units available. The rate for those units is AED 25,000 for 30 nights, with the same AED 3,000 security deposit.
